title: Material checkbox, multicheckbox and toggle contracts
summary: Checkbox registration/display, multicheckbox payload shapes and disabled options, and toggle forwarding boundaries.

facts.claim: FormlyMatCheckboxModule registers checkbox with FormlyFieldCheckbox and the form-field wrapper, and registers boolean as an alias extending checkbox.
facts.context: Material checkbox boolean alias type registration form-field wrapper.
limits: This is the inspected NgModule registration, not a complete application setup recipe.
facts.source_quote: | checkbox | Boolean-oriented control; indeterminate display depends on a nullish control value and enabled indeterminate prop. Its own label and required marker interact with wrapper defaults | [K48](sources.md#k48), [K62](sources.md#k62) |

facts.claim: The Material checkbox binds indeterminate to props.indeterminate && formControl.value == null. Its default props.indeterminate is true.
facts.context: Material checkbox indeterminate null undefined false true default mixed display.
limits: This is a display binding, not a promise of a user-cyclable three-state control or a model-value transformation.
facts.source_quote: | checkbox | Boolean-oriented control; indeterminate display depends on a nullish control value and enabled indeterminate prop. Its own label and required marker interact with wrapper defaults | [K48](sources.md#k48), [K62](sources.md#k62) |

facts.claim: The Material checkbox renders props.label itself and defaults hideLabel to true for wrapper presentation. Its asterisk is rendered when props.required is truthy and props.hideRequiredMarker is not true.
facts.context: Material checkbox label required asterisk hideRequiredMarker hideLabel wrapper.
limits: Hiding the marker does not establish removal of required validation. The marker alone does not prove an affirmative-consent validation contract.
facts.source_quote: | checkbox | Boolean-oriented control; indeterminate display depends on a nullish control value and enabled indeterminate prop. Its own label and required marker interact with wrapper defaults | [K48](sources.md#k48), [K62](sources.md#k62) |

facts.claim: When props.type is not array, the Material multicheckbox change handler patches an object spreading the current value and setting the selected option-value key to the checked Boolean. Unchecking writes false rather than deleting that key.
facts.context: Material multicheckbox default Boolean map payload object uncheck false key retained.
limits: This describes the renderer update path; it does not guarantee initial normalization or conversion of an arbitrary preexisting payload.
facts.source_quote: | multicheckbox | Default path produces a Boolean map keyed by option values; `props.type: 'array'` produces selected-value arrays. Choice affects the payload contract | [K49](sources.md#k49), R15 |

facts.claim: With props.type set to array, Material multicheckbox checks membership using indexOf(option.value). Checking appends the option value; unchecking filters out values strictly equal to it.
facts.context: Material multicheckbox props.type array selected values object identity checked unchecked membership.
limits: This path does not use the Material select compareWith callback, does not promise structural equality for objects, and does not automatically migrate an existing map when the mode changes.
facts.source_quote: | multicheckbox | Default path produces a Boolean map keyed by option values; `props.type: 'array'` produces selected-value arrays. Choice affects the payload contract | [K49](sources.md#k49), R15 |

facts.claim: The Material multicheckbox renders options through formlySelectOptions and async. Each checkbox is disabled when formControl.disabled or option.disabled is truthy.
facts.context: Material multicheckbox options disabled per option whole control mapped options.
limits: Disabling a displayed option is not evidence that its value is removed from the existing payload. No general Observable teardown guarantee is made.
facts.source_quote: | multicheckbox | Default path produces a Boolean map keyed by option values; `props.type: 'array'` produces selected-value arrays. Choice affects the payload contract | [K49](sources.md#k49), R15 |

facts.claim: The Material toggle is a separate @ngx-formly/material/toggle entry point. Its renderer binds the form control, formlyAttributes, required, props.labelPosition and props.color; it renders props.label and defaults hideLabel to true for the wrapper.
facts.context: Material toggle slide toggle labelPosition color required hideLabel control attributes separate entry point.
limits: This renderer evidence does not specify the NgModule registration recipe or prove affirmative-consent validation. Do not infer that all raw MatSlideToggle properties are forwarded.
facts.source_quote: | toggle | Separate `@ngx-formly/material/toggle` entry point. Binds required, labelPosition, color, control and attributes; own label with wrapper label hidden by default | [K52](sources.md#k52) |
